newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leading indicator rises 0.8 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Canada leading indicator rises 0.8 pct in April.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 0.8 percent in April to 192.2 (base 1981) after a 0.9 percent rise in March, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed", reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, rose 0.5 percent in the month to 194.7.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast the smoothed index to rise 0.8 percent.
